Definition: from G1352 and G4007; on which very account:--wherefore.
BiblicalUsage: Wherefore, on which very account, Paul's therefore tying his argument about idols to the command to flee idolatry and to give up meat rather than wound a brother.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that love limits liberty, and the wherefore of the gospel always lands on how I treat my brother.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
